name: Plumage colours v3
changes: From v2: the offer is flat duck egg on every surface (no stripes); Revise & resubmit is striped in the two Full blues on the two card bands; Full requested is a step deeper; the status label moves to the card's top right edge; the paperclip becomes a square tile in the Sent box with a chip-style materials hover; the agency line is ink at 66%; the agent kind tile is teal at 60%; the frame's clipping is restored.

stages.offer: unchanged values (band #c5e0d8, tint #eef6f3, edge #a9cdc2, mark #7fb3a5, rim #7fb3a5, rimHi #e2f0ec); flat everywhere

offerStripes: removed. OFFER_STRIPES and STRIPE_PAPER are deleted.

reviseResubmit.stripesWhere: the grid card's band and the slide-in card's strip only
reviseResubmit.elsewhere: flat #d3deea, the Full requested shade (bars, bubbles, pills, chips, discs, the phone)
reviseResubmit.resubmitted: flat #b9c9da, the Full sent shade, on every surface

statusLabel.where: grid card only, on the card's top edge at the right
statusLabel.position: its vertical centre on the frame's top edge (11px above the band's top, 11px below); 14px in from the band's right edge
statusLabel.text: the status name, as the app already words it

frameClipping: restored (overflow hidden on the grid card's frame)

attachmentsTile.replaces: the paperclip on the grid card
attachmentsTile.where: inside the Sent box, 12px from its right edge, vertically centred
attachmentsTile.shownWhen: exactly when the paperclip is shown today

materialsHover.opens: on hover and on keyboard focus of the tile; closes on leave, blur and Escape
materialsHover.placement: 12px below the tile, its right edge 10px beyond the tile's right edge; opens upwards when there is no room below; never clipped by the card, the grid or the page
materialsHover.pointer: a 12px square turned 45 degrees, on the edge nearest the tile, 25px from the right
materialsHover.title: the tile's accessible name (for example '4 materials'), Special Elite 16px
materialsHover.groups: the groups, order and words the paperclip's pop-up has today; 1px #f1ebe2 between groups
materialsHover.groupHead: Source Serif italic 14px #6b6058; the package name on the same line at the right

chip.icon: MaterialIcon at 16px before the words; a Full manuscript takes the Full status mark from StatusDot
